description: This file defines the PregMatchTypeSpecifyingExtension class, which integrates with PHPStan to provide static analysis support for regex match methods in the Preg class. It specifies how certain static methods like match, isMatch, matchAll, etc., should influence variable types during static analysis.

classes.name: PregMatchTypeSpecifyingExtension
classes.description: A PHPStan extension class that specifies type inference rules for preg-related static methods in the Preg class, aiding static analysis by providing expected return types based on method calls.

methods.name: setTypeSpecifier
methods.description: Sets the TypeSpecifier instance used to create type specifications for regex matches.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name this extension supports, which is 'Preg'.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Determines whether a given static method call on the Preg class is supported by this extension (e.g., match*, isMatch* methods).

methods.name: specifyTypes
methods.description: Core method that inspects the method call, extracts arguments, and determines the inferred types for the matches based on regex results, influencing static type analysis.
